description.en: OmniInteract is a streaming benchmark for real-time omnimodal LLMs evaluated through native online inference over audio-visual streams. It contains 250 videos with 1,430 temporally grounded response slots (1Q1A and 1QnA), with each slot including trigger, response window, and target answer. Metrics include IA-QTF1, Interruption Diagnostic Suite, and Nested Chain Completion Score.

claire_radar.whyItMatters: Real-time omnimodal assistants must process streaming audio-visual input and decide whether and when to respond without access to future content, a capability not captured by offline video benchmarks. OmniInteract provides a native streaming evaluation protocol, revealing that current models remain weak in streaming interaction.
